limit: Static cross-reference of the pinned Delphi EXE. Preference objects reached only through TPreferenceManager load/save are counted as persistence, not runtime effects. Effects are read from disassembly, not executed; GUI rendering, dialog event dispatch and the Toolkit site list are not exercised. .NET results are UTF-16 substring and decompiled literal scans: the eDLT hit is the HVAC widget "TemperatureUnits" list, not this preference.

preferences.cli: The CLI has no Scene Manager action list; C-Gate load-change port configuration is not managed.
preferences.effect: OnUpdate handlers disable the Capture Scene and Live Scene actions when set.
preferences.name: LoadChangePortDisable

preferences.cli: The CLI streams C-Gate events verbatim (cgate events); it has no Application Log view.
preferences.effect: Suppresses Application Log load-change entries and changes the log heading/pause action state.
preferences.feature: Application Log view and load-change event processing
preferences.name: ApplicationLogDisable

preferences.cli: thermostat-temperature convert --preferences FILE applies the same low-byte rule to the 14 scalar conversions. Unit dialogs are GUI-only; the CLI documentor does not emit temperatures.
preferences.effect: All reads test the low byte of the integer (+0x20); non-zero selects Fahrenheit conversions.
preferences.feature: Thermostat/SENTEMP conversions, dialogs, documentor HTML and network-log text
preferences.name: TemperatureUnit

preferences.cli: CLI C-Gate sessions never pause or enable event monitoring around DBGETXML; adding the re-enable would change session event levels for every database read, so it is recorded, not emulated.
preferences.effect: Copied into TcgcProjectLoad/TcgcDBGetXML/TcgcPPGetUnitSpecCatalog. Their begin/end hooks test it with no dependent action (the pause is compiled out). Only TcgcDBGetXML.OnProcessResults acts: when false, a completed DBGETXML re-enables event monitoring (TcgcEvent level 6 = "event e5s1c1").
preferences.feature: C-Gate PROJECT LOAD, DBGETXML and unit-catalogue commands
preferences.name: DoNotPauseEventsWhileLoadingProject

preferences.cli: cgate --preferences FILE selects 127.0.0.1 for empty/LOCAL when --host is omitted and rejects a named site (the site list is not modelled). The write-back is not performed.
preferences.effect: Startup reads the string; empty becomes LOCAL. UpperCase(site)=LOCAL opens the local C-Gate; other names resolve through the Toolkit C-Gate site list. Opening a site writes LOCAL for a localhost/127.0.0.1 site, otherwise the site name.
preferences.feature: Startup site selection and site-open write-back
preferences.name: Default Site
